downstream_strip.description: Start from downstream vendor driver and remove/replace vendor framework pieces to approximate upstream.

noted_gaps: Large fail-closed surface from unclear downstream logic

risks: Carries forward legacy abstractions and non-upstream lifecycle structure
High chance of retaining vendor-only symbols accidentally
Large structural churn makes review and validation harder

advantages: Preserves upstream APIs, lifecycle, and structure by default
Converts effort into targeted additive deltas only
Minimizes vendor residue risk and patch volume
upstream_first.description: Start from upstream lpass-rx-macro.c and add only validated downstream functional deltas.

ported_items.downstream_source_line: 5035 (downstream only exposes generic qcom,lpass-cdc-rx-macro; no per-SoC mapping)
ported_items.what_was_added: Add binding-declared compatibles missing in upstream rx_macro_dt_match: qcom,kaanapali-lpass-rx-macro, qcom,sm8650-lpass-rx-macro, qcom,sm8750-lpass-rx-macro, qcom,x1e80100-lpass-rx-macro.
ported_items.why_needed: Binding declares these variants; upstream driver match table lacks them. Upstream-first additive support requires these entries.

transferable_rules: Start from upstream when a close driver already exists; treat downstream as logic donor only.
Port only items with direct evidence and HIGH confidence; mark unclear items FAIL_CLOSED.
Let DT binding vs upstream compatible delta drive the minimum safe additive patch.
Require anti-copy checks to prove the result is a new artifact (not byte-copy of either side).
